dct_description_sm: Satellite tags were deployed on 5 killer whales (Orcinus orca) in Milne Inlet and Tremblay Sound (7241′57″N 07757′33″W) during several encounters with 15-20+ animals in 2013. This fieldwork was part of an ongoing study of killer whales in the Eastern Canadian Arctic using satellite telemetry, biopsy, and photo identification to learn more about killer whale distribution and migration, diet, social structure, and population size.
dct_title_s: Killer whale (Orcinus orca) satellite telemetry, Milne Inlet, Nunavut, 2013 (NGMP ID EC05)
